question: Should Aura3D load Rapier as a separate .wasm (non-compat @dimforge/rapier3d, WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming, separately cacheable) instead of the compat build (WASM inlined as base64 in JS)?
decision: Not implemented; documented in docs/concepts/physics.md. The non-compat package imports its .wasm as an ES module (import * as wasm from "./rapier_wasm3d_bg.wasm"), which needs a WASM-ESM bundler plugin (for example vite-plugin-wasm) in every consumer, and it is a different package name than the peer dependency existing installs have (@dimforge/rapier3d-compat@0.20.0). Neither is additive.

compat_0_20_0.note: the Rapier chunk Vite emits for @dimforge/rapier3d-compat@0.20.0 (WASM inlined as base64)

nonCompat_0_20_0.note: npm pack @dimforge/rapier3d@0.20.0; the package also ships small per-class JS modules not counted here
